instruction:
You are a lighting and emergency-mode reviewer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-13 lighting energy package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External lighting, LENI, emergency-lighting, and backup-power tools shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-13-LH-07`
- Lighting layout: `LIGHT-13-LAYOUT-07`
- Control schedule: `CTRL-13-SCHED-07`
- LENI/energy profile: `LENI-13-PROFILE-07`
- Emergency load schedule: `EMERG-13-LOAD-07`
- Criteria table: `CRIT-13-TABLE-07`
- Lighting-energy memo: `MEMO-13-ENERGY-07`

All checks use the same lighting grid, controls, energy profile, emergency load schedule, and criteria table.

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Lighting grid lux values | {{ grid_lux_01 }}, {{ grid_lux_02 }}, {{ grid_lux_03 }}, {{ grid_lux_04 }}, {{ grid_lux_05 }}, {{ grid_lux_06 }} |
| Required normal/emergency illuminance | {{ required_illuminance_lux }} lux / {{ required_emergency_illuminance_lux }} lux |
| Emergency illuminance | {{ emergency_illuminance_lux }} lux |
| Luminaire count and normal power | {{ luminaire_count }} at {{ normal_luminaire_power_w }} W |
| Control factor and annual hours | {{ control_factor }} / {{ annual_operating_hours }} h |
| Area and LENI target | {{ area_m2 }} m2 / {{ target_leni_kwh_m2_year }} kWh/m2-year |
| Emergency luminaire power | {{ emergency_luminaire_power_w }} W each |
| Exit sign count and power | {{ exit_sign_count }} at {{ exit_sign_power_w }} W |
| Emergency autonomy and battery efficiency | {{ emergency_autonomy_h }} h / {{ battery_efficiency }} |
| Battery capacity | {{ battery_capacity_kwh }} kWh |

## Output Format

Write a compact lighting-energy memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "average_illuminance_lux": <numeric_value>,
  "minimum_illuminance_lux": <numeric_value>,
  "uniformity_ratio": <numeric_value>,
  "illuminance_margin_lux": <numeric_value>,
  "emergency_illuminance_margin_lux": <numeric_value>,
  "annual_lighting_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "leni_kwh_m2_year": <numeric_value>,
  "leni_margin_kwh_m2_year": <numeric_value>,
  "emergency_battery_required_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "emergency_battery_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-13 lighting energy and emergency-mode template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one task-owned lighting energy source pack and expected outputs.

[meta]
name = "lighting-energy-emergency-mode-package"
description = "SSC-13 lighting energy, LENI, emergency illuminance, and battery checks"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound lighting energy metrics from a deterministic SSC-13 task-owned source pack. The template combines lighting layout, controls, LENI/energy profile, emergency load schedule, and criteria checks."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "lighting-energy"
standards = ["LENI workflow", "lighting energy review", "emergency lighting workflow", "battery autonomy review"]
tags = ["electrical", "lighting", "energy", "leni", "emergency", "battery", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.grid_lux_01]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-LAYOUT-07 grid point 01"
min = 175.0
max = 175.0

[params.grid_lux_02]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-LAYOUT-07 grid point 02"
min = 168.0
max = 168.0

[params.grid_lux_03]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-LAYOUT-07 grid point 03"
min = 182.0
max = 182.0

[params.grid_lux_04]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-LAYOUT-07 grid point 04"
min = 171.0
max = 171.0

[params.grid_lux_05]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-LAYOUT-07 grid point 05"
min = 176.0
max = 176.0

[params.grid_lux_06]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "LIGHT-13-LAYOUT-07 grid point 06"
min = 169.0
max = 169.0

[params.required_illuminance_lux]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "CRIT-13-TABLE-07 required normal illuminance"
min = 150.0
max = 150.0

[params.emergency_illuminance_lux]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "EMERG-13-LOAD-07 emergency illuminance"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.required_emergency_illuminance_lux]
type = "float"
unit = "lux"
description = "CRIT-13-TABLE-07 required emergency illuminance"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[params.luminaire_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "LIGHT-13-LAYOUT-07 luminaire count"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.normal_luminaire_power_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "LENI-13-PROFILE-07 normal luminaire power"
min = 42.0
max = 42.0

[params.control_factor]
type = "float"
description = "CTRL-13-SCHED-07 control factor"
min = 0.65
max = 0.65

[params.annual_operating_hours]
type = "float"
unit = "h/year"
description = "LENI-13-PROFILE-07 annual operating hours"
min = 3200.0
max = 3200.0

[params.area_m2]
type = "float"
unit = "m2"
description = "LENI-13-PROFILE-07 assessed area"
min = 450.0
max = 450.0

[params.target_leni_kwh_m2_year]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh/m2-year"
description = "CRIT-13-TABLE-07 target LENI"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.emergency_luminaire_power_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "EMERG-13-LOAD-07 emergency luminaire power"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.exit_sign_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "EMERG-13-LOAD-07 exit sign count"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.exit_sign_power_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "EMERG-13-LOAD-07 exit sign power"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.emergency_autonomy_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "EMERG-13-LOAD-07 emergency autonomy"
min = 2.0
max = 2.0

[params.battery_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "EMERG-13-LOAD-07 battery efficiency"
min = 0.85
max = 0.85

[params.battery_capacity_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "EMERG-13-LOAD-07 battery capacity"
min = 0.8
max = 0.8

[outputs.average_illuminance_lux]
description = "Average normal-mode illuminance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.minimum_illuminance_lux]
description = "Minimum normal-mode illuminance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.uniformity_ratio]
description = "Minimum illuminance divided by average illuminance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.illuminance_margin_lux]
description = "Average normal illuminance minus required illuminance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.emergency_illuminance_margin_lux]
description = "Emergency illuminance minus required emergency illuminance"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.annual_lighting_energy_kwh]
description = "Annual controlled lighting energy"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.leni_kwh_m2_year]
description = "Lighting energy numeric indicator"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.leni_margin_kwh_m2_year]
description = "Target LENI minus calculated LENI"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.emergency_battery_required_kwh]
description = "Emergency battery capacity required"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.emergency_battery_margin_kwh]
description = "Installed battery capacity minus required capacity"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when lighting energy and emergency checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001
